Merge pull request #1023 from mureinik/javadoc

Fix broken link in Mockito javadoc

Fix broken link in Mockito javadoc

Commit 6a82c0 (included in Mockito 2.7.14) changed
MockSetting#useConstructor's signature to accept an Object...
argument. While this change is backwards compatible (as calls can
continue passing an empty argument list), it broke the javadoc
reference to useConstructor() in Mockito's javadoc.

This patch fixes that broken link.

Change release build to JDK 7 with binary compatibility for Java 6

Travis configuration update

Avoid sniffing when skipping release. This way we avoid duplicate errors and also make builds tiny bit faster.

Moved animal sniffer to separate Gradle file

This way it will be easier to get rid of it when we drop Java 6 support. It will also make it easier to install latest version of mockito release tools.
